name: compose
expression: (()=>{if(document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Stop assistant response"]'))throw Error('Busy');const s=document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Assistant permissions"]');if(s){Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set.call(s,'readonly');s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}const n=document.querySelector('textarea');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set.call(n,"Form comparison QA: I entered these synthetic values manually in the roofing worksheet. You do not have a form-read tool, so use only the exact inputs supplied here. Execute calculate_draft_roof_area now for one plane id Synthetic QA roof, grossPlanAreaM2 100, pitchDegrees 0, measurementReference QA supplied synthetic horizontal area, not a source measurement; pitchReference QA supplied zero-degree pitch. One opening id Synthetic QA opening, planAreaM2 5, measurementReference QA supplied synthetic opening area. Report the actual gross/opening/net result, compare with worksheet net 95 m², retain draft/quote-ineligible status, and finish with a concise Developer review grounded in the executed receipt. Do not mutate project data or claim to inspect the form.");n.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return true})()

name: send
expression: (()=>{const b=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Send assistant message"]');if(!b||b.disabled)throw Error('Send unavailable');b.click();return new Date().toISOString()})()
